title: Nondegenerate GRPO groups
formal_object: IID Bernoulli rewards with probability p for G>=2 rollouts, policy score h=grad log pi, action-independent baseline b.
assumptions: IID Bernoulli is only a diagnostic model; actual correlated graded/native rewards need their own estimator law.
Policy support and square-integrable scores justify E[h]=0.
Selection/rejection of all-equal groups changes the sampling measure.

operations.condition: IID reward draws at fixed policy
operations.output: Probability of a mixed group is 1-p^G-(1-p)^G.

derivation_steps.justification: All-zero and all-one outcomes are disjoint under IID Bernoulli.
Differentiate the scalar second moment; the score zero-mean identity removes b.

derivation_steps.statement: A mixed-group rejection sampler conditions on reward; the original policy-gradient expectation is not automatically preserved.
derivation_steps.justification: No derived importance correction, support proof or group-normalized estimator currently connects this calculation to a complete GRPO update.

method_expression: Incomplete: valid group-efficiency diagnostics do not specify a corrected cost-accounted GRPO sampling/update algorithm.
distinguishing_prediction: Only the IID nondegenerate-group frequency law is established; a method benefit per generated token remains a lead.
falsifier: Biased group selection, reward correlations or extra rollouts erasing estimator efficiency refute the proposed rationale.
closest_alternative: GRPO/DAPO/UniME-R1 native estimators, ordinary no-rejection GRPO and valid action-independent baseline controls.
decisive_comparison: Requires primary full algorithm and published reward benchmark; no generated dispatch matrix or invented native reward cases.
legacy_code_audit: No fit(I07), rollout producer, qualified reward or current executable estimator.
review_limit: Pending consequential complete estimator construction; no math-ready method claim.
